---

Figures inside Quarto's own divs: callouts, tabsets, page columns, and
conditional content, each on its own and inside a `.panzoom` div. lightbox is
off, so clicking an image panzoom leaves alone does nothing.

An image on a tab not selected, or in a collapsed callout, opens once the reader
selects the tab or expands the callout.

The plots are drawn with these helpers:

```{r}
# A collage: `n` panels side by side, like a wide patchwork figure.
collage <- function(n = 12) {
  set.seed(1)
  par(mfrow = c(1, n), mar = c(3, 3, 2, 1))
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    plot(
      cumsum(rnorm(200)),
      type = "l",
      main = paste("Panel", i),
      xlab = "",
      ylab = "",
      col = hcl.colors(n)[i],
      lwd = 2
    )
  }
}

wave <- function(k = 1) {
  x <- seq(0, 4 * pi, length.out = 400)
  col <- hcl.colors(4, "Dark 3")[k]
  plot(
    x,
    sin(k * x),
    type = "n",
    main = paste("Wave", k),
    xlab = "x",
    ylab = "sin(kx)"
  )
  polygon(
    c(x, rev(x)),
    c(sin(k * x), rep(0, length(x))),
    col = adjustcolor(col, 0.35),
    border = NA
  )
  lines(x, sin(k * x), lwd = 2, col = col)
}
```

## Image in a callout {#c1 expect-open="panzoom"}

An image with `.panzoom` in a callout. It opens in panzoom.

```markdown {.show-source}
::: {.callout-note title="A note with a photo"}

![Waves breaking below the clay cliffs at Aquinnah, Martha's Vineyard.](../../images/mv-1.jpg){.panzoom width=50% fig-alt="Waves breaking below grassy clay cliffs at Aquinnah"}
:::
```

## Callout in a `.panzoom` div {#c2 expect-open="panzoom"}

A callout with a plain image, inside a `.panzoom` div. The div marks every image
in it, so the image opens in panzoom.

```markdown {.show-source}
::: {.panzoom}
::: {.callout-tip title="A tip with a photo"}

![Edgartown Lighthouse, Martha's Vineyard.](../../images/mv-2.jpg){width=50% fig-alt="A white lighthouse against a blue sky"}
:::
:::
```

## Collapsed callout {#c3 expect-open="panzoom"}

An image with `.panzoom` in a callout that starts collapsed. Expand the callout,
and the image opens in panzoom.

```markdown {.show-source}
::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Expand for a photo"}

![A gingerbread cottage in Oak Bluffs, Martha's Vineyard.](../../images/mv-3.jpg){.panzoom width=50% fig-alt="A shingled gingerbread cottage with pink and green trim, behind a garden path"}
:::
```

## Tabset {#c4 expect-open="panzoom"}

Two images with `.panzoom`, one on each tab of a tabset. Each opens in panzoom
on its own, the second once its tab is selected.

```markdown {.show-source}
::: {.panel-tabset}
### Sunset

![Sunset at Chilmark Beach, Martha's Vineyard.](../../images/mv-0.jpg){.panzoom width=50% fig-alt="Sunset over a sandy beach, with a tall rock stack against the sun"}

### Sailboat

![A sailboat off Edgartown, Martha's Vineyard.](../../images/mv-4.jpg){.panzoom width=30% fig-alt="A sailboat with a flag-striped sail off a sandy beach"}
:::
```

## Gallery across tabs {#c5 expect-open="panzoom" expect-steps="true"}

Two images with `.panzoom`, joined by `group="tabs"`, on different tabs. They
open in panzoom as a two-image gallery, each with its own caption: the next
button shows the image on the other tab without selecting it.

```markdown {.show-source}
::: {.panel-tabset}
### Cliffs

![Waves breaking below the clay cliffs at Aquinnah, Martha's Vineyard.](../../images/mv-1.jpg){.panzoom group="tabs" width=50% fig-alt="Waves breaking below grassy clay cliffs at Aquinnah"}

### Lighthouse

![Edgartown Lighthouse, Martha's Vineyard.](../../images/mv-2.jpg){.panzoom group="tabs" width=50% fig-alt="A white lighthouse against a blue sky"}
:::
```

## Tabset in a `.panzoom` div {#c6 expect-open="panzoom"}

A tabset with a plain image on each tab, inside a `.panzoom` div. Each opens in

```markdown {.show-source}
::: {.panzoom}
::: {.panel-tabset}
### Cottage

![A gingerbread cottage in Oak Bluffs, Martha's Vineyard.](../../images/mv-3.jpg){width=50% fig-alt="A shingled gingerbread cottage with pink and green trim, behind a garden path"}

### Sunset

:::
:::
```

## Collage across the screen {#c7 expect-fit="height"}

A 25 × 2 inch collage in a `.column-screen` div, so it spans the window. It is
still a strip, so it opens in panzoom at screen height.

````markdown {.code-overflow-wrap .cell-code}
::: {.column-screen}
```{{r}}
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   A row of 12 small line plots of random walks, each in its own color
#| panzoom: true
#| fig-width: 25
#| fig-height: 2
#| fig-cap: "A 25 × 2 inch collage of 12 random walks."

collage(n = 12)
```
:::
````

::: {.column-screen}
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   A row of 12 small line plots of random walks, each in its own color
#| panzoom: true
#| fig-width: 25
#| fig-height: 2
#| fig-cap: "A 25 × 2 inch collage of 12 random walks."

collage(n = 12)
```
:::

## Plot in the page column {#c8 expect-fit="contain"}

A plot with `column: page`, wider than the text. It opens in panzoom whole.

```{r}
#| fig-alt: "A sine curve, shaded between the curve and the x-axis"
#| column: page
#| panzoom: true
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-cap: >-
#|   Wave 2: y = sin(2x); the area between the curve and the x-axis is shaded.

wave(k = 2)
```

## Plot in the margin {#c9 expect-open="panzoom"}

A plot in a `.column-margin` div. It opens in panzoom, at full size.

````markdown {.code-overflow-wrap .cell-code}
::: {.column-margin}
```{{r}}
#| fig-alt: "A sine curve, shaded between the curve and the x-axis"
#| panzoom: true
#| fig-cap: >-
#|   Wave 3: y = sin(3x); the area between the curve and the x-axis is shaded.

wave(k = 3)
```
:::
````

::: {.column-margin}
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-alt: "A sine curve, shaded between the curve and the x-axis"
#| panzoom: true
#| fig-cap: >-
#|   Wave 3: y = sin(3x); the area between the curve and the x-axis is shaded.

wave(k = 3)
```
:::

## Conditional content {#c10 expect-open="panzoom"}

An image with `.panzoom` in a `.content-visible` div for HTML. It opens in
panzoom. The `.content-hidden` div next to it leaves nothing on the page.

```markdown {.show-source}
::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
![A sailboat off Edgartown, Martha's Vineyard.](../../images/mv-4.jpg){.panzoom width=30% fig-alt="A sailboat with a flag-striped sail off a sandy beach"}
:::

::: {.content-hidden when-format="html"}
![Sunset at Chilmark Beach, Martha's Vineyard.](../../images/mv-0.jpg){.panzoom}
:::
```

## Gallery from a div {#c11 expect-open="panzoom" expect-steps="true"}

Two images in a `.panzoom` div with `group="div-gallery"`. The div's group joins
them, so either opens in panzoom in a two-image gallery.

```markdown {.show-source}
::: {.panzoom group="div-gallery" layout-ncol="2"}
![Waves breaking below the clay cliffs at Aquinnah, Martha's Vineyard.](../../images/mv-1.jpg){fig-alt="Waves breaking below grassy clay cliffs at Aquinnah"}

![Edgartown Lighthouse, Martha's Vineyard.](../../images/mv-2.jpg){fig-alt="A white lighthouse against a blue sky"}
:::
```
